Method of Attack: Injects highly convincing PayPal iframes to hijack the checkout process on compromised online stores
Harvests payment and personal information via JavaScript-based skimmer hidden using steganography inside an image on the compromised store's server
Pre-fills fake PayPal payment forms with stolen order data during checkout
Exfiltrates stolen payment data to remote servers
Clicks the legitimate order button behind the malicious iframe to send victim back to legitimate checkout
Attack Vector: Web skimming (e-skimming) via injected JavaScript skimmer on checkout pages
